text:
rachel (partnerships): Quick thread — NorthbridgeAI submitted a model claiming 'open weights; commercial redistribution ok'. They attached a contributors CSV and an unlabeled tarball. No signed tags. What's our stance for marketplace and HW bundling?

northbridge-rep: hi all — we intend permissive redistribution. we can provide commit hashes and a signed release if that's required. also open to a restricted HW carveout.

jess (marketplace): For marketplace we need explicit rights. If redistribution is allowed, we must know: (1) allowed channels (downloads / partner bundles / reseller), (2) attribution text, (3) whether ShareAlike applies. Without sigs, mark as hosted-only.

tom (legal): Initial red flags: no cryptographic provenance. Ask for sigstore/GPG-signed release, contributor CLAs or DCO, and dataset manifests. If any dataset is CC-BY-SA that may block downstream redistribution. Also need export-control self-report (origin countries).

anu (hw-partner): For hardware bundles, we require a binary redistribution grant to authorized resellers, package signing, and a vulnerability contact. We'll also want a short SOW for preloads.

devops-bot: PROV_CHECK: no verified signatures detected in uploaded artifacts. FLAG: provenance_missing (HIGH).

rachel (partnerships): Action items: (1) Northbridge to provide signed release (sigstore/GPG) + commit hashes + CLAs + dataset manifest + export-origin list (ETA 72h). (2) Tom to draft a redistribution addendum and attestation template (ETA 48h). (3) Jess to prepare marketplace flags for: hosted-only / partner-bundle-restricted / redistributable. (4) Anu to draft HW-bundle checklist and SOW template.

jess (marketplace): If they can't produce sigs/CLAs within 72h, we'll only allow hosted usage with limited promotion and add badge: "Redistribution: Pending".

tom (legal): Quick draft clause snippet: "Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive license to host the Model. Distribution of model binaries or compiled artifacts to third parties, resellers, or hardware partners requires Provider's prior written consent and an executed redistribution addendum. Provider warrants it has the rights to grant such licenses and that no ShareAlike obligations apply to the Model."

rachel (partnerships): Also hold all co-marketing until legal clears redistribution and export checks. If they want a joint announcement require 2-week copy review. Scheduling a 20-min sync with Northbridge + Legal tomorrow 10:00 PT.

northbridge-rep: we'll get the signed release and CLAs ASAP, thanks.

rachel (partnerships): Recap posted to the partnerships board once docs arrive. tagging @tom @jess @anu. :white_check_mark:
